title: Retry Queue
description: An async job queue retries failed jobs, but some jobs run twice. Trace one job through failure and retry.

phases.title: Bug Fix
phases.prompt: Some jobs execute more than once. Trace a job through enqueue, execution, failure and retry. Find the root cause and make a focused fix. Use Run tests to check your reading.

phases.title: Implement
phases.prompt: Add RetryQueue.cancel(id): a pending or waiting job must never run again, a running job finishes but is not retried, and cancelling an unknown id returns false. Emit a 'cancelled' event.

phases.title: Optimize
phases.prompt: drain() removes work with Array.shift() and every retry re-enters the pending array. Explain the cost for a queue with 100k jobs and propose (or implement) a better structure. State the time complexity before and after.
